display.intent: Update fee sharing in a takeover
display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.authority} updates the fee sharing config ${accounts.sharingConfig} of the coin ${accounts.mint} for a takeover of the coin by a new creator
${accounts.socialClaimAuthority} pays the fees held for user ${data.userId} of platform ${data.platform} to ${accounts.recipient}

accounts.name: quoteMint
docs: Quote mint for claim

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.socialClaimAuthority} pays the fees held for user ${data.userId} of platform ${data.platform}, collected in the token ${accounts.quoteMint}, to ${accounts.recipient}

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays rent when [`temp_wsol_token_account`] is created (`init_if_needed`); receives rent when it is closed after the relay CPI.

accounts.name: quoteMint
docs: Quote mint from donation fee pda.

accounts.name: donationFeePdaAta
docs: WSOL ATA owned by `donation_fee_pda`.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.payer} sends the fees held in the donation account ${accounts.donationFeePda} to the donation relay program

accounts.name: configId
docs: stored on the PDA, so distinct `config_id`s for the same `base_mint` derive distinct addresses.

accounts.name: sharingConfig
docs: (derived from `[SHARING_CONFIG_SEED, base_mint]`)

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.payer} creates the donation account ${accounts.donationFeePda} for the coin ${accounts.baseMint} and the donation campaign ${accounts.configId}

instructions.name: createFeeSharingConfig
docs: Create Fee Sharing Config

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.payer} sets up creator fee sharing for the coin ${accounts.mint}: its creator fees now go to the sharing config ${accounts.sharingConfig}
${accounts.payer} creates the fee account ${accounts.socialFeePda} for user ${data.userId} of platform ${data.platform}

instructions.name: extendFeeConfig
docs: Realloc the fee_config PDA to [`FeeConfig::CURRENT_SIZE`] (signer pays rent delta).

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.user} pays to enlarge the fee config account ${accounts.feeConfig}

instructions.name: getFees
docs: Get Fees

display.interpolatedIntent: Looks up the trading fees in the fee config ${accounts.feeConfig}
Looks up the trading fees in the fee config ${accounts.feeConfig}
${accounts.payer} sets up buyback vault ${accounts.buybackVault}, number ${data.index}, for the token ${accounts.mint}

instructions.name: initializeFeeConfig
docs: Initialize FeeConfig admin

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.admin} creates the fee config ${accounts.feeConfig} for the program ${accounts.configProgramId}
${accounts.authority} creates the fee program's global settings, with ${data.socialClaimAuthority} as the social claim authority

instructions.name: revokeFeeSharingAuthority
docs: Revoke Fee Sharing Authority

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.authority} makes ${data.newAuthority} the authority of the fee program's global settings
${accounts.authority} sets the fee program's claim rate limit to ${data.claimRateLimit}
${accounts.authority} sets the fee program's disable flags to ${data.disableFlags}
${accounts.admin} sets the flat fees the fee config ${accounts.feeConfig} charges on Pump coins quoted in a token other than SOL or a listed stablecoin
${accounts.authority} makes ${data.socialClaimAuthority} the fee program's social claim authority
${accounts.authority} moves the SOL and the ${accounts.mint} tokens of buyback vault ${accounts.buybackVault} to ${accounts.destination}

instructions.name: transferFeeSharingAuthority
docs: Transfer Fee Sharing Authority

instructions.name: updateAdmin
docs: Update admin (only callable by admin)

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.admin} makes ${accounts.newAdmin} the admin of the fee config ${accounts.feeConfig}
${accounts.authority} makes ${data.newAuthority} the authority of buyback vault ${accounts.buybackVault}
${accounts.authority} sets the claim rate limit of buyback vault ${accounts.buybackVault} to ${data.claimRateLimit}

instructions.name: updateFeeConfig
docs: Set/Replace fee parameters entirely (only callable by admin)

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.admin} replaces the fee tiers and the flat fees of the fee config ${accounts.feeConfig}

instructions.name: updateFeeShares
docs: Update Fee Shares, make sure to distribute all the fees before calling this

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.authority} sets who shares the creator fees of the coin ${accounts.mint}, after the fees already collected are paid to the current shareholders

docs: The coin's current shareholders, in the order the sharing config lists them: the creator fees
already collected are paid to them before the new shares apply. When the fee token is not SOL,
their token accounts for it follow, in the same order. When the coin has left its bonding curve,
its PumpSwap pool comes last.

instructions.name: updateFeeSharesV2
docs: Update Fee Shares, make sure to distribute all the fees before calling this

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.authority} sets who shares the creator fees of the coin ${accounts.mint}, after the fees already collected are paid to the current shareholders

docs: The coin's current shareholders, in the order the sharing config lists them: the creator fees
already collected are paid to them before the new shares apply. When the fee token is not SOL,
their token accounts for it follow, in the same order. When the coin has left its bonding curve,
its PumpSwap pool comes last.

instructions.name: updateStableFeeConfig
docs: Set/Replace fee parameters entirely (only callable by admin)

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.admin} replaces the stable fee tiers of the fee config ${accounts.feeConfig}

instructions.name: upsertFeeTiers
docs: Update or expand fee tiers (only callable by admin)

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.admin} updates or adds fee tiers of the fee config ${accounts.feeConfig}, starting at position ${data.offset}

instructions.name: upsertStableFeeTiers
docs: Update or expand fee tiers (only callable by admin)

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.admin} updates or adds stable fee tiers of the fee config ${accounts.feeConfig}, starting at position ${data.offset}
${accounts.user} withdraws from their referral vault ${accounts.referralVault}: SOL to their wallet or, when a token is named below, that token to the destination token account
